g.text: Independent wild-type runs do not agree with one another

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: 19 complete 200 ns runs of the same wild-type complex (18 on Anvil, 1 on Expanse). The two halves of a run mostly agree,

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: but separate runs settle at different levels, and stacking switches fully on or off.
